svg.title: 01 | Two-Pi test bench
svg.desc: Illustrative bench. Worker Pi 1 reads a JCI FEC over BACnet/IP. Worker Pi 2 reads a Niagara station on a Windows PC over baskStream. The paths are independent. Both export ASHRAE 223P Turtle.
svg.text: Illustrative bench. Two independent edges. Not a default pipeline.
Priority array. Writes off by default
SCRAM, then HTTP Basic if needed
WSS uses the station URL host and port
Same bacnet://<device>/<type>,<instance> identity from either Pi
QUDT local-name units. Haystack is an overlay only.
reconcile compares the two Turtle files. It does not run on either Pi.
Named graph per edge. Port 8780. Does not talk to the FEC or the station.
Each Pi is a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B running Docker, DuckDB, and the open-hvac-edge 223P export.
It reads only the configured points. It does not crawl the BAS. SPARQL stays off unless EDGE_ENABLE_SPARQL is set.
The Niagara station on the Windows PC integrates the same FEC. Both exports go to the central collector.
